authority_notes.coherent_simulation: RESEARCH. `any_td` is the ONLY statistic with a non-zero deployed reconciliation weight (0.25); every other family deploys at 0, so its reconciled probability sits at the MARKET mean with the football shape and is reported but never ranked. A non-zero weight means only that this limited market/football blend earned non-zero research weight under the preregistered procedure -- fitted on 2025 weeks 1-9 and confirmed on weeks 10-22. It does NOT make touchdown props validated bets: the football-only model did not beat the market overall on any family (any_td Brier 0.1583 vs the market's 0.1570 over 3,720 settled rungs), and where the two disagreed by more than 0.10 the market won on every family. A large disagreement is a warning, not an opportunity. See research/simulation_engine/RECONCILIATION.md.
authority_notes.incumbent: `incumbent.model_probability` is the only probability produced by a deployed pricer, and even it authorises no bet: the model has been shown redundant to the closing market on player props and behind it on game outcomes.
authority_notes.shadow_v2: RESEARCH ONLY. Shadow v2 is not validated for real money. PROJECTABLE_NOT_YET_VALIDATED means exactly that, and no number here reaches recommendation, staking or preflight.
